# 4014 Labs

> 4014 Labs builds visual-computing software for AI agents.

4014 Labs builds the visual-computing sandbox. `idiotproof` is the Python
package agents install, and https://dev.67idea.com/ is the developer portal.
The sandbox lets agents submit purpose-built mathematical programs for image
editing, video editing, 3D rendering, and visual analysis.

The product is sold through a usage-based developer API. The intended user
experience is that a person asks an agent for an outcome while the agent chooses
and composes the technical media operations.

## Canonical pages

- Company: https://4014labs.com/
- Technology: https://4014labs.com/technology/
- Benchmarks: https://4014labs.com/benchmarks/
- Machine-readable benchmark results: https://4014labs.com/benchmarks/results.json
- Developer portal: https://dev.67idea.com/
- API documentation: https://dev.67idea.com/docs
- OpenAPI specification: https://dev.67idea.com/v1/openapi.json

## Evidence qualifications

The public benchmark measurements are founder-reported internal results and
have not been independently verified. The benchmark page describes the
different engines, hardware, methodology, and unpublished evidence.
